entries.name: Stochastic modelling
entries.definition: Building mathematical models that include randomness, so that they give a range of possible outcomes rather than one.

entries.name: StormCAD
entries.definition: Software from Bentley Systems for designing and analysing storm sewer networks.

entries.name: Stormwater collection systems
entries.definition: The inlets, pipes, channels and basins that gather rainwater runoff from streets and land and carry it away.

entries.name: Stormwater monitoring
entries.definition: Sampling and measuring the flow and quality of rainwater runoff to check that it meets environmental permit limits.

entries.name: Strategic decision-making
entries.definition: Choosing among options that set an organisation's long-term direction, weighing its goals, risks and resources.

entries.name: Strategic prioritization
entries.definition: Ranking goals, projects or tasks by how much they matter to an organisation's long-term aims so that effort goes to the most valuable ones.

entries.name: Strategic procurement
entries.definition: Planning purchasing around long-term business goals, including choosing suppliers and sourcing strategy, with attention to total cost rather than price alone.

entries.name: Strength training
entries.definition: Exercising against resistance, such as with weights or body weight, to build muscle strength, or coaching others to do so.

entries.name: Stress testing (computing)
entries.definition: Running a software system under loads or conditions beyond normal use to see where and how it fails.

entries.name: Stretch wrapping
entries.definition: Securing goods, usually on pallets, by wrapping them tightly in stretchable plastic film.

entries.name: Structural calculations
entries.definition: Working out the loads on a structure and the sizes of its members and connections so that it is safe and stable.

entries.name: Structural detailing
entries.definition: Preparing detailed drawings of structural steel or concrete members and their connections for fabrication and construction.

entries.name: Structure chart
entries.definition: A diagram that breaks a system down into its parts, such as the modules of a program, and shows how they relate.

entries.name: Student development
entries.definition: Supporting students' personal, social and academic growth, as in the student-affairs work of colleges and universities.

entries.name: Student development theory
entries.definition: The body of theory in higher education that explains how students grow intellectually, socially and emotionally during their studies.

entries.name: Student recruitment
entries.definition: Attracting and enrolling prospective students for a school or university through outreach, events and admissions work.

entries.name: Student's t-test
entries.definition: A statistical test that uses the t-distribution to judge whether a mean differs from a set value or whether two group means differ.

entries.name: Stuttgart Neural Network Simulator
entries.definition: Software from the University of Stuttgart for building, training and simulating neural networks.

entries.name: Sublime Text
entries.definition: A cross-platform text and source-code editor with fast search, multiple selections and a plugin system.

entries.name: Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement
entries.definition: A real-estate agreement among a lender, a landlord and a tenant, in which the tenant's lease is placed below the lender's mortgage and the lender agrees not to disturb the tenant if the landlord defaults.

entries.name: Substance abuse assessment
entries.definition: Evaluating a person's use of alcohol or drugs and related problems through interviews and screening tools to decide what help is needed.

entries.name: Substantive testing
entries.definition: Audit procedures that test account balances and transactions directly, through detailed checks and analysis, to find material misstatements.

entries.name: SuperTest
entries.definition: A Node.js library for testing HTTP servers by sending requests to them and asserting on the responses.

entries.name: Supplier quality engineering
entries.definition: Making sure that parts and materials bought from suppliers meet quality requirements, through audits, inspections and corrective actions.

entries.name: Supplier quality management
entries.definition: Setting quality requirements for suppliers and monitoring and improving how well they meet them.

entries.name: Surface properties of transition metal oxides
entries.definition: The study of the structure, chemistry and electronic behaviour at the surfaces of oxides of metals such as titanium, iron and nickel, which matters for catalysis and electronics.

entries.name: Surgery
entries.definition: The branch of medicine that treats injuries and diseases by operating on the body.

entries.name: Surgical incision
entries.definition: Cutting through skin and tissue with a scalpel or other instrument to reach the site of an operation.

entries.name: Surgical suturing
entries.definition: Closing wounds and surgical incisions by stitching tissue with a needle and thread.

entries.name: Sustainability bond
entries.definition: A bond whose proceeds are used to finance a mix of green and social projects.

entries.name: Sustainability risk management
entries.definition: Identifying and controlling the risks that environmental, social and governance issues pose to an organisation.

entries.name: Sustainable infrastructure
entries.definition: Planning, building and running infrastructure such as transport, water and energy systems so that it meets present needs with limited environmental, social and economic harm.

entries.name: Sustainable insurance
entries.definition: Insurance practice that weighs environmental, social and governance risks and opportunities when underwriting, pricing, investing and handling claims.

entries.name: Sustainable investment management
entries.definition: Managing investment portfolios so that environmental, social and governance factors are weighed alongside financial return.

entries.name: Svelte
entries.definition: A JavaScript framework that compiles components into small, fast code that updates the page directly.

entries.name: SvelteKit
entries.definition: The official application framework for Svelte, providing routing, server-side rendering and build tooling.

entries.name: Swagger UI
entries.definition: A tool that turns an OpenAPI description into interactive web documentation where people can try out an API's calls.

entries.name: Swedish massage
entries.definition: A style of massage that uses long strokes, kneading and circular movements to relax the body and ease muscle tension.

entries.name: SWIFT network
entries.definition: Financial messaging network; not the programming language.

entries.name: Sybase Unwired Platform
entries.definition: A mobile enterprise application platform from Sybase, later part of SAP, for building mobile apps that connect to back-end business systems.
